Therefore ||nabla^k partial_t^l u||_infinity <= C_{k,l} M^{k+2l+1} uniformly in ancient time.

Temporal persistence of a fixed-time lambda-superlevel set therefore yields local measure <= C I R/[lambda^2 min(R^2,lambda/K_t)].
For large R at fixed lambda this is only O(I M^4 R lambda^{-3}), leaving an unbounded radius factor.
